messages:
maria: heads up, after the auth key rotation at 09:12 we saw a cluster of connections that fully re-established instead of doing a silent token refresh. clients hit reconnect -> new session created, duplicate token billing spike. anyone else seeing this in prod?

jon: yes saw it. console shows a bunch of sessions labeled as 'regen' and then a quick route-swap. looks like our resume path isn't being honored when the client presents the rotated token. :thinking_face:

kevin: digging into logs now. initial suspicion: auth middleware returns 204 vs 401 on midstream token swap, client treats it as terminal and reconnects fresh. grabbing samples.

maria: that matches what support reported — users getting short stalls and then full reconnects, which triggers a new live route + billing. we should treat this as high-priority for the rollouts UX and routing policy.

kevin: paste of the lightweight trace (sanitized):
```
[09:12:03] ws_conn id=abc123 auth=rotating request=/stream
[09:12:04] auth-check middleware responded 204 (token-refresh)
[09:12:04] resume-handler: no resume-token found -> fallback full-connect
[09:12:04] routing: claim new route shard=eu-west-1/rs-7 -> allocate socket
[09:12:05] billing: create session charge user=acct-987 amt=1
```

jon: ok seeing the 204 path. previously we relied on clients to attach resume-id in the same handshake. some older SDKs don't. But still, server should try to keep the old session alive if client reconnects within grace window.

sara: console telemetry is confusing too — sessions count goes down then up but route attribution sometimes shows both old and new shard for the same client. dashboard panels are misleading during this event. we should tag these in the console as "auth-regen" so SRE/CS can quickly filter.

maria: agree. short-term: can we add a sticky grace where a recent session id can be reattached for X seconds even if the auth header changed? would reduce churn. long-term: tighten resume semantics so rotated tokens map to same session id if we see previous ephemeral cookie.

kevin: prototype idea: on auth rotate, emit an event to route-manager to keep the lease for +30s and accept resume attempts that present either token v1 or v2 if they include prior-session header. rollback safe? Any objections?

jon: sounds reasonable. we do need to ensure this doesn't create a replay auth hole. security: only permit reattach if resume proof + client IP matches within threshold. add HMAC of previous session id as anti-replay.

maria: good point. also need console flag to surface these events as 'auth-regen' with a count and example trace id. CS will want a simple query.

sara: open question: how do we show this in per-route latency? right now it looks like latency spike because new route claim time is included. maybe we should annotate traces where resume=false and auth-rotate=true so dashboards can exclude claim time from p50/p95.

kevin: agreed. implementation checklist I'm thinking:
- route-manager: extend lease TTL + conditional resume acceptance (+30s)
- auth-service: add resume-proof header when rotating tokens
- server: annotate telemetry: resume_attempt=(true|false), auth_rotate=(true|false), claim_time_ms=
- console: new filter + a small panel for auth-regen incidents

maria: can you put a canary behind a feature flag so Dedicated tenants can opt-in? we should avoid global risk for now.

kevin: will push a canary. deploy-bot: starting canary rollout to 5% of traffic (eng-runtime -> route-manager v2).

deploy-bot: ✅ canary started for route-manager v2: 5% traffic, tag=auth-regen-probe, rollout_id=rn-2026-03-23-01

jon: when can we get traces wired to console? need that before widening canary. otherwise SRE won't be able to triage.

kevin: I can add the telemetry annotations in the next patch; ETA ~2h. will send a diff. also adding a small test harness for token-rotation scenario.

sara: i'll add dashboard panels and a saved query for CS: "auth-regen events last 24h". also will add a quick playbook note in incidents.

maria: awesome. if all goes well let's increase canary to 25% tonight, but only after we confirm no duplicate-billing events in the last 30m. keep monitoring on billing and session-count alerts. :thumbsup:

jon: noted. i'll also add an alert suppression rule for console noise to avoid paging on expected short-lived spikes during rollout.

kevin: pushing patch now. linking PR when ready.

maria: thanks — please post the PR and the sample trace ids so I can hand to support for followups.

kevin: PR posted: https://git.internal/rn/route-manager/pulls/482 (auth-regen probe + telemetry) — sample trace ids: trace-zz1, trace-zz2.

sara: dashboard link: https://console/internal/dashboards/auth-regen-probe (draft). adding CS playbook.

maria: closing the loop — I'll coordinate with CS and SRE once we have 25% stability. good job team.
